brief:
Israeli companies that supply drones, military sensors and surveillance technology are among 45 firms expected to participate in technology summits in Hyderabad and other Indian cities, Middle East Eye reported. The companies have been linked to operations in Gaza.

The events represent a significant commercial opportunity for Israeli technology sectors amid international scrutiny over their role in the conflict. Details of the summits' dates, specific venues beyond Hyderabad, and the complete list of participating companies were not immediately available.

title: Israeli firms to attend tech summits in India despite genocide links
